body:
Ethan Park: Seeing a weird entitlement activation delay in staging. AWS purchase goes through, webhook hits `/v1/marketplace/aws/entitlements`, 200 OK, but Console still shows “Pending activation” for ~25+ min. Anyone else seeing this today?

marketplace-bot: (staging) marketplace_webhook_processed provider=aws event=EntitlementUpdated status=200 request_id=stg_9b6f8e2a sku=RW-HOSTED-API-PRO org_link_state=unlinked

Leila Farouk: Yep, I hit it on the E2E run just now. Test step “org link -> entitlement active” timed out at 12m. Retried manually and it flipped eventually.

Cole Summers: Pulling logs. I see us writing the entitlement row, but the activation job isn’t firing until the next poll cycle.

Cole Summers: From `entitlement-worker`:
```
msg="entitlement not activatable yet" provider=aws
reason="missing customer_identifier" entitlement_id=ent_stg_01JMYR6S8T9YQ
next_retry_in=900s
```
So we’re backing off to 15 min on the first failure.

Chloe Martin: In Console this manifests as the wizard being stuck on step 2. We only refresh entitlement state every 60s, but if the backend says “not activatable” it just keeps showing Pending with no hint. :/

Rafael Mendes: 15 min backoff on staging seems… aggressive. Is this new? Also we should be emitting a metric so SRE can alert when activation lag > X.

Ethan Park: It’s new-ish from the idempotency changes. We treat missing `customerIdentifier` as “transient” but we bumped backoff so we don’t hammer AWS.

Allison Grant: Checking metrics in staging: `marketplace.entitlement.activation_lag_seconds p95` spiked to ~1600s in the last hour. No alert wired yet (only in prod). Can add a staging alert quick.

Cole Summers: Root cause looks like we sometimes get `EntitlementUpdated` without `customerIdentifier` on the first call in staging (maybe their sandbox). We then wait 15m before re-fetching via ResolveCustomer.

Cole Summers: Proposed quick fix: reduce initial retry/backoff in staging (and maybe prod) to something like 60s/120s for the first 5 attempts, then exponential. Right now it’s hard-coded to 900s on first retry.

Rafael Mendes: +1. Also make the activation job run immediately when the org links, regardless of last failure time. Right now if the buyer links their org 2 min after purchase, we still won’t retry until that 15m timer expires.

Chloe Martin: That would help. Today the user path is: purchase -> open console -> link org -> still pending. If we kick activation on link, we can collapse perceived latency.

Ethan Park: Agree. Two changes:
1) Lower retry for missing `customerIdentifier` (treat as “expected transient”)
2) When org_link_state changes to linked, enqueue activation attempt (ignore backoff)

Ethan Park: I can put up a patch behind `marketplace_activation_fast_retry` flag. Cole can you sanity check the billing/entitlement mapping side?

Cole Summers: Yep. As long as we keep idempotency (same entitlement_id) it’s fine. Just don’t double-grant add-ons; activation handler should remain upsert.

Allison Grant: Please add counters for: `activation_attempts_total{reason=missing_customer_identifier}` and a histogram for activation lag (we can reuse the prod dashboards). I’ll wire staging panels.

Leila Farouk: For my test, would be great if Console also surfaced “Waiting for marketplace confirmation, retrying” vs generic Pending. Not required for the hotfix, but it’ll save me time.

Ethan Park: Hotfix scope: backend retry + activation-on-link. Console messaging can be a follow-up.

Rafael Mendes: What’s the ETA? Partner review is using staging a lot this week.

Ethan Park: Patch in ~1 hr, deploy to staging right after. If it works, we can decide whether to roll to prod or keep behind flag.

marketplace-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed `marketplace-service` to staging (build 8f3c1d2). Feature flag `marketplace_activation_fast_retry` enabled for 100% staging.

Leila Farouk: Re-ran the flow. Activation flipped in ~90s after org link. E2E passed. :thumbsup:

Rafael Mendes: Nice. Let’s keep the flag but also create an action item to adjust the policy for prod with guardrails.

Ethan Park: Done. I’ll open a follow-up to (a) add prod alert threshold (activation lag p95 > 5m for 10m) and (b) improve Console copy. Closing the loop here.
